data.note: Dec-26 SRW closed $5.65½ on 25 Nov, −4¼¢; KC HRW Dec −8½¢ to $6.04, below $6 for the first time in 9 months. Weekly change shown is for the week to 20 Nov. US closed 26 Nov.

data.title: Wheat import committee weighs another 500,000 t on top of the 800,000 t tender
data.summary: The Wheat Import Steering Committee under Deputy PM Ishaq Dar is considering a further 500,000 t of wheat imports for 2026-27, days after approving 800,000 t (TCP tender closes 30 Nov); the 800,000 t process is already under way.

data.title: CBOT 25 Nov: Dec SRW wheat $5.65½ (−4¼¢), KC below $6 for first time in 9 months; corn up 4–6¢
data.summary: ADMIS: Dec SRW wheat fell 4¼¢ to $5.65½ and KC Dec 8½¢ to $6.04; corn closed 4–6¢ higher with Dec at a new weekly high, beans +4–10¢ and meal another $4–8. Crush margin improved to $1.86/bu and meal's share of crush value rose to 55.1%.
